rows.notes: The paper is a system design proposal (Raspberry Pi, soil moisture and temperature sensors, Android app) describing architecture, module breakdown and an on/off algorithm. It reports no measurements, field trial, prototype test data, survey or model runs; the 'Result and Discussion' section only lists system modules. The abstract asserts that water will be saved and manual intervention reduced, but this is a design claim, not a reported result. Hence no own evidence that smart irrigation addresses water scarcity.

notes: Three-page conceptual/design paper with no empirical data; cannot support any evidence question beyond Q1 = no.
